items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: Merrill Cook did that Shades of Jelly Roll album with Doc Sushan singing.

ctx.x: Cook. K-O-C-H. Merrill Cook. Merrill Cook did that Shades of Jelly Roll album with Doc Sushan singing.
Oh. Doc was fine. You ever hear that? No, I don't think I did, no.
